scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
I've been studying ways to enhance an armor to maximize its capability.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
我一直在研究如何强化护甲，以最大限度地发挥其性能。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
I am in charge of Enchanting Armors. Simply put, I've been studying ways to power-up armor.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
我负责护甲的附魔。简单来说，就是研究如何提升护甲的能力。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Enchanting is an awesome skill that infuses a mysterious status powers into the armor's hidden socket.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
附魔是一项强大的技能，可以将神秘的状态属性注入护甲隐藏的插槽中。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
However, you have to keep in mind that if there are two armors of the same kind in your possession, the Enchantment will be applied in the order they are placed in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
不过，请务必注意，如果您拥有两件同种类的护甲，附魔将按照它们在物品栏中的排列顺序进行。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
In that case, the Enchantment may be applied to an item which you didn't mean to Enchant. So just bring ^5555ffONE Armor^000000 you want enchanted to be safe...
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
在这种情况下，附魔可能会应用到您并不想附魔的物品上。为了安全起见，请只带^5555ff一件护甲^000000来...

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
I'm not responsible for what would happen if you have more than one of the same kind in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
如果您物品栏中有两件以上同种类的护甲，发生任何后果我概不负责。

scripts.text: Non Slotted Armor.
scripts.translation: 无插槽护甲

scripts.text: Slotted Armor.
scripts.translation: 有插槽护甲

scripts.text: High Grade Armor.
scripts.translation: 高级护甲

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再说

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Please come back when you have any interest in enchanting your armor.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
如果您有兴趣附魔护甲，请随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
If by any chance, you would want to enchant your armor, bring me 400,000 zeny and the armor you want to enchant and you are all set to go.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
如果您想附魔护甲，请带上400,000 Zeny和您想要附魔的护甲，就可以开始了。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Socket enchant will cost you 400,000 zeny. And there will be a random option enchanted. Of course, there is a chance of breaking your armor.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
插槽附魔的费用是400,000 Zeny。附魔的属性是随机的。当然，护甲也有损坏的风险。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Hmm? There's nothing to be enchanted!
Please come back with just ONE equipment to be enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
嗯？没有可以附魔的物品！
请只带一件想要附魔的装备回来。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
First and most importantly.
^ff5555Existing Refine Level of the Armor
and Cards will be GONE.^000000
Do you still want to try an Enchant?
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
首先，也是最重要的一点。
^ff5555护甲现有的精炼等级
和卡片将会消失。^000000
您确定还要尝试附魔吗？

scripts.text: Hmm... Let me think it over.
scripts.translation: 嗯...让我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: Go ahead.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Well, I can't blame you. Safety first, eh?
Now you have a nice day.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
好吧，我不怪你。安全第一嘛。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Quite of an adventurer huh? Well, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
真是个大胆的冒险者啊。那么，开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Sorry, but you don't have enough zeny.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
抱歉，您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Apprentice Craftsman]
Well that's too bad.
The requested equipment has failed to enchant.
scripts.translation:
[工匠学徒]
真遗憾。
您请求附魔的装备失败了。
